::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Nagpur sensor company founded 2017 (CEO Shashank Kumar; Prof R. Vasant Kumar of Cambridge is a director). Makes hydrogen detectors; its CMOS-MEMS gas-sensor platform is licensed from Cambridge Enterprise and was prototyped at IIT Bombay's nanofab. The DLI project adds a CMOS analog front-end SoC.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Gas sensors and a CMOS data-acquisition analog front-end SoC to read them out.

**Why these scores**

- **Domain difficulty 3/5:** MEMS gas sensors with a CMOS analog front-end SoC.
- **IP ownership 3/5:** CMOS-MEMS sensor platform licensed from Cambridge Enterprise; AFE SoC is its own.
- **Design completeness 2/5:** Sensor prototyped at IIT Bombay; the AFE SoC is a DLI project with no tape-out reported.
- **Market readiness 3/5:** Already sells hydrogen detectors, though not yet with its own SoC.
